title: UFOs showing up at nuclear sites, waiting for humanity to evolve
summary: Jesse Michels tells of UFOs showing up at nuclear sites, waiting for humanity to evolve, about unspecified at nuclear sites, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: some sort of prime directive where they're waiting for us to get less violent. They're keeping an eye on us. They're showing up at nuclear sites which they do at all of our nuclear sites,

related.note: Both concern UFOs appearing at nuclear sites, but this telling explains them as aliens under a prime directive waiting for humanity to become less violent, where the story explains them as future humans guarding their timeline.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes an idea that the beings behind UFOs follow a kind of rule against interfering, a "prime directive", and are waiting for humanity to become less violent. He says they keep an eye on us and show up at all of our nuclear sites. If true, it would mean we are being quietly watched until we grow up as a species.
